articles.headline: Nvidia teams up with Samsung, LG, Kakao to advance physical AI
articles.summary: Nvidia is expanding its partnerships with South Korean technology companies Samsung Electronics, LG Electronics, and Kakao Mobility to accelerate artificial intelligence development in semiconductors, autonomous driving, and robotics. Samsung is applying AI to semiconductor research and manufacturing using Nvidia's PhysicsNeMo framework, achieving a roughly 1,600-fold increase in computing speed during thermal and mechanical simulations. Kakao Mobility is developing a Level 4 autonomous driving system utilizing Nvidia's Hyperion platform and Halos safety technologies, primarily integrating into Kia purpose-built vehicles. LG Electronics is using Nvidia's Isaac GR00T robotics AI models to improve robot training and manufacturing simulations, having demonstrated its CLOiD robot operating in a real-world manufacturing environment.
articles.summary_zh: 英伟达正在扩大与韩国科技巨头三星电子、LG电子和Kakao Mobility的合作伙伴关系，以加速在半导体、自动驾驶和机器人技术领域的人工智能开发。 三星电子通过应用英伟达的PhysicsNeMo框架将AI用于半导体材料研究和制造，使热学和力学模拟的计算速度提升了约1600倍。 Kakao Mobility正在利用英伟达的Hyperion平台和Halos安全技术开发Level 4自动驾驶系统，计划主要整合到起亚的专用汽车中。 LG电子则使用英伟达的Isaac GR00T机器人AI模型来改善机器人训练和制造环境仿真，并已完成CLOiD机器人在真实制造环境中运行的演示。

articles.headline: Nvidia Surprises With Direct Investments in Four Korean AI, Robotics Startups
articles.summary: Nvidia announced at its AI Day Seoul event at COEX that it will make direct investments in four Korean startups: Point2 Technology, Upstage, Motif Technologies, and Realworld. Additionally, Samsung Electronics and Hyundai Motor Group formalized a strategic partnership during an event at Samsung's Seocheon Training Center in Yongin, expanding cooperation into physical AI and robotics while jointly developing robot-dedicated batteries. Nvidia, SK Telecom, and Rebellions also signed a memorandum of understanding to develop a next-generation AI computing system, incorporating Rebellions' R200 neural processing unit into Nvidia's NVLink Fusion high-speed interconnect network. SK Telecom will build the combined system at its AI data center for performance verification, with Rebellions aiming to supply it in 2028.
articles.summary_zh: 英伟达在首尔COEX举行的AI Day Seoul活动上宣布，将直接投资四家韩国初创公司：Point2 Technology、Upstage、Motif Technologies和Realworld。 此外，三星电子和现代汽车集团在三星位于龙仁的西川培训中心举行的一场活动中正式建立集团层面的战略伙伴关系，将合作范围扩展至物理AI和机器人领域，并联合开发机器人专用电池。 英伟达、SK电信和Rebellions还签署了一份谅解备忘录，开发下一代AI计算系统，将Rebellions的R200神经常处理单元整合到英伟达的NVLink Fusion高速互联网络中。 SK电信将在其AI数据中心构建该联合系统以验证性能，Rebellions计划于2028年开始供货。

articles.headline: Boston Dynamics adds wheels to Atlas humanoid to test whole-body control
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics released a video showing its Atlas humanoid robot using wheels attached to its legs to move around, combining classical model-based motor control with whole-body reinforcement learning. Controls engineer Andy Wu explained that the wheeled Atlas is a research testbed rather than a product, designed to test actuation limits and unstructured environment adaptability. The system was trained entirely in simulation and executed in real life by mounting an off-the-shelf scooter rim onto Atlas' existing ankle actuator using a custom adapter. The experiment demonstrates that Atlas can smoothly switch between fast rolling on flat terrain and articulated legged motion over irregular surfaces. The company is preparing to ramp up Atlas testing at Hyundai facilities as it continues developing the humanoid's capabilities.
articles.summary_zh: 波士顿动力发布了一段视频，展示其Atlas人形机器人利用安装在腿部的轮子进行移动，该实验将经典的基于模型的电机控制与全身强化学习结合起来。 控制工程师安迪·吴解释说，带轮子的Atlas是一个研究测试平台而非产品，旨在测试驱动极限和非结构化环境适应性。 该系统在模拟中训练并在现实中执行，仅通过定制适配器将现成的滑板车轮辋安装到Atlas现有的脚踝执行器上。 该实验表明，Atlas能够在平坦地形上的快速滚动与不规则表面上的关节式腿部运动之间平稳切换。 该公司正准备在现代的设施中加强Atlas的测试，同时继续开发该人形机器人的各项功能。

articles.headline: Nvidia Pushes Physical AI Into Korea's Manufacturing Core
articles.summary: Nvidia is expanding its physical AI initiative in South Korea by partnering with manufacturing giants such as Samsung to integrate accelerated computing, simulation tools, and robotics frameworks into industrial workflows. The collaboration spans semiconductor fabrication, robotics using the Isaac framework and Jetson modules, and autonomous vehicle perception testing via the Drive platform. This effort leverages Korea's manufacturing base to deploy AI systems that control robots, optimize chip design, and operate under industrial conditions. Nvidia aims to embed its platform across the physical AI ecosystem, though financial terms and deployment timelines were not disclosed.
articles.summary_zh: 英伟达正在韩国扩大其实体人工智能业务，与三星等制造巨头合作，将加速计算、仿真工具和机器人框架集成到工业工作流程中。 该计划涵盖半导体制造、使用Isaac框架和Jetson模块的机器人技术，以及通过Drive平台进行的自动驾驶汽车感知测试。 此举利用韩国的制造基础来部署控制机器人、优化芯片设计并在工业条件下运行的人工智能系统。 英伟达旨在将其实体人工智能生态系统的计算平台进行嵌入，不过双方未披露财务条款和部署时间表。

articles.headline: AGCO, Agility Robotics plan humanoid robot pilot at Kansas plant
articles.summary: AGCO and Agility Robotics have signed a commercial agreement to deploy artificial intelligence-powered humanoid robots in manufacturing operations. The United States pilot, scheduled to begin in 2027, will take place at AGCO's Hesston, Kansas, production facility. Agility Robotics' Digit robot will perform assembly and production tasks, including sorting, stacking parts, and placing totes in storage, to automate repetitive and physically demanding work. Digit utilizes artificial intelligence to adapt to changing workflows, while Agility Robotics' cloud-based Agility Arc platform manages robot fleets for integration without extensive infrastructure changes.
articles.summary_zh: AGCO与Agility Robotics签署了一项商业协议，将在制造业务中部署人工智能驱动的人工智能人形机器人。 这项美国试点计划定于2027年开始，将在AGCO位于堪萨斯州黑斯顿的生产设施进行。 Agility Robotics的Digit机器人将执行装配和生产任务，包括分拣、堆叠零件以及将周转箱放入存储区，以实现重复性和体力消耗大的工作的自动化。 Digit利用人工智能来适应不断变化的工作流程，而Agility Robotics基于云的Agility Arc平台则负责管理机器人机群，以便在无需进行大规模基础设施更改的情况下进行集成。

articles.headline: 智启物理世界，巧手对话全球，灵心巧手在第七届世界媒体峰会上，讲述具身智能中国创新故事
articles.summary: On November 7, the 7th World Media Summit opened in Beijing, hosted by Xinhua News Agency and the Beijing Municipal Government under the theme "Media Mission and Cooperative Action in Intelligent Transformation. " As a representative embodied AI enterprise in Beijing, Lingxin Qiaoshou participated deeply. Co-founder and Vice President Zuo Jiaping attended the opening ceremony at the Great Hall of the People, and Vice President and International Business Head Weber Su presented technical explanations at the Zhongguancun Exhibition Center. The company showcased core technological achievements and interactive experiences across dual venues at the Beijing Hotel and the Zhongguancun Exhibition Center. From November 4 to 6, its piano robot "Lingxin Yuefu" performed classic tracks at the Beijing Hotel, relying on high-performance dexterous hands, millisecond-level multi-finger coordination control, and emotional deep learning models. The company also displayed the Linker Hand product series covering direct drive, linkage, and tendon-driven technologies. At the Zhongguancun Exhibition Center, the Linker Hand L20 demonstrated precision tasks such as threading a needle, achieving sub-millimeter repeatable positioning accuracy with 21 degrees of freedom. Guests also experienced the Linker Open TeleDex multi-modal data collection and teleoperation system with force feedback. Lingxin Qiaoshou adheres to full-stack self-research, integrating hardware, perception, motion control, multi-modal data, and embodied large models to build a comprehensive technical system.
articles.summary_zh: 11月7日，第七届世界媒体峰会在北京启幕，本届峰会由新华社与北京市人民政府共同主办，主题为“智能变革中的媒体使命与合作行动”。 北京市具身智能代表性企业灵心巧手深度参与，联合创始人、副总裁左家平出席开幕式，副总裁兼国际业务负责人苏同明在的中关村展示中心开展技术讲解。 北京饭店展区与中关村展示中心双场景联动，集中展示了核心技术成果。 “灵心乐府”钢琴机器人于11月4日至6日在北京饭店展区演奏中外经典乐曲，展区同时展出涵盖直驱、连杆、腱绳三大技术路线的Linker Hand全系列灵巧手产品矩阵。 在中关村展示中心，拥有21个自由度的Linker Hand L20灵巧手完成了“穿针引线”演示，现场还开放了Linker Open TeleDex多模态数据采集与遥操作系统供嘉宾体验。 灵心巧手坚持全栈自研，构建了硬件、感知、运动控制、多模态数据、具身大模型一体化的技术体系。

articles.headline: 人形机器人板块爆发！宇树科技涨超12%，股价重回800元，跻身A股第三高价股
articles.summary: On November 10, the humanoid robot sector surged significantly, with Unitree seeing a stock price increase of over 12%, returning to 800 yuan per share and becoming the third-highest-priced stock on the A-share market. Its total market value exceeded 3200 billion yuan. Other concept stocks such as Tongxing Technology hit the 20% limit-up, alongside Guangyang股份, Fulai Xincai, and Yijiahe. Catalytic news included Elon Musk stating that Tesla has started early mass production of Optimus at its Fremont factory, with external customer deliveries expected around the end of 2027. Company-level positive news also emerged: Unitree Chairman, General Manager, and CTO Wang Xingxing stated at the 2026 World Physical AI大会 that physical AI has shown breakthrough signs and could reach an inflection point in one to two years, and reiterated at the World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit that 2027 will be the critical threshold for the robotics industry. In industrial cooperation, China National Petroleum Corporation Kunlun Manufacturing and Unitree plan to jointly establish an enterprise for industrial embodied AI robots. Meanwhile, Apple's new robot autonomous control system HALO achieved a validation success rate of 91% across 360 skill tests in six un-scanned, untrained strange scenes using a Unitree G1 robot.
articles.summary_zh: 11月10日，人形机器人板块大幅走高，宇树科技涨幅超12%，股价重回800元/股，跻身A股第三高价股，总市值突破3200亿元。 同星科技20%涨停，光洋股份、福莱新材、亿嘉和等涨停。 特斯拉CEO马斯克表示特斯拉已在弗里蒙特工厂启动Optimus早期量产，预计2027年底左右开始向外部客户交付。 宇树科技董事长、总经理兼首席技术官王兴兴在2026世界物理AI大会上表示物理AI在一到两年或两到三年就能迎来拐点，并在世界互联网大会乌镇峰会上表示2027年将成为机器人行业临界点。 产业链合作方面，中国石油集团昆仑制造有限公司与宇树科技等拟共同设立工业具身智能机器人合营企业。 同时，苹果全新机器人自主控制系统HALO在宇树G1机器人上完成验证，平均成功率达到91%。

articles.headline: 人形机器人板块异动拉升，宇树科技市值重返3200亿元，相关概念股大涨
articles.summary: On the morning of November 10, the humanoid robot sector rallied sharply, with Unitree soaring over 11% to reach a total market capitalization of 3234 billion yuan. Additionally, Tongli Technology hit its 20cm limit-up, while Fenglong股份, Tianqi Shares, Guangyang Shares, Xiangyang Bearing, and Yijiahe also surged to the limit-up. In terms of news, Tesla CEO Elon Musk recently stated that Optimus will begin delivery around the end of 2027, though delivery may take the form of leasing rather than selling. Musk noted that the initial cost of Optimus might be comparable to an electric vehicle, at approximately $300,000 initially, dropping to around $20,000 over time, and estimated that it will take at least a year to reach full mass production after initial use in Tesla's own factories. Furthermore, JPMorgan Chase released a research report at the end of October upgrading Unitree's rating by two notches from "Underweight" to "Overweight," raising its December 2027 target price from 300 yuan to 995 yuan, citing technical progress shown at the Hangzhou Physical AI Conference and the rollout speed of the H2-X new model as reasons for an earlier adoption curve for the physical AI industry.
articles.summary_zh: 11月10日上午，人形机器人板块异动拉升，宇树科技涨超11%，总市值达3234亿元。 通力科技20cm涨停，锋龙股份、天奇股份、光洋股份、襄阳轴承、亿嘉和等涨停。 特斯拉CEO马斯克日前表示，“擎天柱”将在2027年底左右开始交付，交付形式可能是“租”而不是“卖”，初期成本约为3万美元，之后降至2万美元左右，至少需要一年时间才能达到全面量产并先在特斯拉自有工厂中使用。 摩根大通10月底发布研报，将宇树科技评级由“低配”上调两级至“增持”，把2027年12月目标价从300元大幅上调至995元，并判断物理AI产业采纳曲线将提前到来。

articles.headline: 新华社与优必选发布仿生机器人主播，张艺谋负责形象设计
articles.summary: On November 9, at the 7th World Media Summit Artificial Intelligence and Chinese Modernization Forum, Unitree Robotics, alongside Xinhua News Agency and director Zhang Yimou, officially unveiled the world's first bionic humanoid robot news anchors, "Xinyan" and "Xinyu". Both anchors replicate real humans at a 1:1 ratio, with Zhang Yimou serving as the chief image design director. Powered by Xinhua's AI political information intelligent agent, along with Unitree's bionic skin, embodied AI hardware, and emotional large models, they possess live broadcasting capabilities. The bionic anchors feature authoritative and credible information sources anchored by Xinhua, natural voice and appearance through Unitree's multi-modal large models and bionic expression systems, and a closed-loop news broadcasting workbench. Five regular application scenarios have been planned for Xinyan and Xinyu, covering museums, education, government affairs, external propaganda, and cutting-edge exploration. Zhang Yimou stated he focused on lens aesthetics and character temperament to balance solemn news requirements with natural bionic realism. Xinhua New Media Center Director Qian Tong noted that robot anchors serve as new newsroom colleagues rather than protagonists to assist journalists. Unitree Founder, Chairman, and CEO Zhou Jian explained that the robot builds a brain-expression-control technical link backed by the "Xinhua Yudian" intelligent agent.
articles.summary_zh: 11月9日，在第七届世界媒体峰会人工智能与中国式现代化论坛上，优必选联合新华社、张艺谋研发的全球首个仿生人形机器人新闻主播“新言”与“新语”正式官宣。 “新言”与“新语”采用1:1真人比例复刻，张艺谋担任形象主创设计师，基于新华社AI时政资讯智能体及优必选仿生皮肤、具身智能硬件、情感大模型等技术具备现场出镜播报能力。 仿生人形机器人新闻主播具备权威可信、声形自然、生产闭环三大特质，并规划了文博、教育、政务、外宣及前沿探索五个常态化落地应用场景。 张艺谋表示其致力于在庄重严谨的新闻表达要求与自然细腻的仿生真实感之间寻找平衡点。 新华社新媒体中心主任钱彤表示机器人主播是编辑部的新工种而非新主角。 优必选创始人、董事长兼CEO周剑介绍机器人构建了大脑、表达、控制三位一体的技术链路。

articles.headline: 扎克伯格牌机器人，中国造- 产业链
articles.summary: Meta is entering the humanoid robot sector, with its first prototype, Max, built by the Chinese company Fourier Intelligence. According to foreign media, Meta partnered with Fourier to complete the humanoid robot prototype in just three months, and has now started developing the second-generation product. Max stands about 1.5 meters tall, weighs about 48 kilograms, is equipped with an NVIDIA Jetson Thor chip, features dual speakers in the chest, a facial display screen for human-like expressions, and five-fingered hands capable of picking up small objects. Meta's requirements for Max include basic movement and human-computer interaction, such as recognizing sounds from 5 meters away and gestures from 3 meters away. Meta's Robotics Product Vice President Li-Chen Miller worked at Fourier's Shanghai factory for nearly two months to advance the research, and Max was internally demonstrated in August. In September, development of Max 2 began with a redesigned torso, improved hand manipulation, a visual content projection display, and extra sensors for stairs. Meta stated that the collaboration with Fourier is intended for internal research and experimentation with no current sales plans. Meta's core objective with Max is tied to its AI agent Muse, treating the robot as its physical carrier. Meta also acquired Assured Robot Intelligence in May. Meanwhile, Fourier started in exoskeletons and rehabilitation robots before moving into humanoid robotics, providing Meta with hardware and manufacturing experience while bypassing the challenge of building a hardware system from scratch.
articles.summary_zh: Meta正杀入人形机器人赛道，第一台原型机由中国公司傅利叶打造。 据外媒透露，Meta与傅利叶仅用三个月便完成名为Max的人形机器人原型，目前已启动第二代产品研发。 Max身高约1.5米，重约48公斤，搭载英伟达Jetson Thor芯片，胸部内置两个扬声器，面部配有表情显示屏，双手采用五指设计。 Meta机器人产品副总裁李晨·米勒曾在傅利叶上海工厂工作近两个月推进研发，Max于8月底在内部峰会上展示，9月启动Max 2研发。 Meta发言人表示合作主要用于内部研究和实验，无销售计划。 研发Max的核心目标与AI智能体Muse有关，将其作为物理载体。 Meta此前在5月收购了机器人AI初创公司Assured Robot Intelligence。 傅利叶在双足运动、灵巧手和触觉感知等方面积累了经验，合作使Meta能够借助中国企业的研发和制造能力快速完成原型开发并投入AI模型和交互系统研发。

articles.headline: 「ロボットが工場で働く時代」へ！ 三菱電機、AIが人型ロボットと工作機械を連携させる新技術を開発
articles.summary: 三菱電機株式会社は2026年10月21日、ヒューマノイドとCNC工作機械をフィジカルAIを介して連携させる加工システムを開発したと発表した。 同社によると、ヒューマノイドとの連携を前提としたNCシステムとして業界初となる。 作業者が自然言語で指示すると、AI加工タスクプランナーが必要な作業を自動生成し、ロボットと工作機械に振り分けて実行状況を管理する。 加工準備、清掃、完成品の取り出しなどをロボットに任せることで省人化を目指す。 このシステムには同社のAI技術ブランド「Maisart」を活用したフィジカルAIを搭載しており、2026年10月26日からのJIMTOF2026でデモンストレーション展示を予定している。
articles.summary_zh: 三菱电机株式会社于2026年10月21日宣布开发出通过フィジカルAI（物理AI）使人形机器人与CNC工作机械联动的加工系统。 据该公司称，这是行业首个以与人形机器人联动为前提的NC系统。 当作业者通过自然语言发出指示时，AI加工任务规划器会自动生成所需作业，分派给机器人与工作机械并管理执行情况。 通过将加工准备、清扫、成品取出等工作交给机器人来完成，旨在实现制造现场的省人化。 该系统搭载了利用三菱电机AI技术品牌“Maisart”开发的新物理AI，并计划于2026年10月26日起在JIMTOF2026第33届日本国际工作机械见上进行演示展示。

articles.headline: 【フォートナイト】ソニーのロボット犬「aibo」がバディに登場！1,500V-BUCKS、残り6日
articles.summary: 本日のアイテムショップに、ソニーのロボット犬「aibo」がバディとして登場した。 価格は1,500V-BUCKSで、販売期間は残り6日である。 aiboは1999年に初代が家庭用エンターテインメントロボットとして25万円で発売され、2006年に生産を終了したが、2018年に現行モデルのERS-1000として復活した。 フォートナイト内では白い体に茶色の耳と尻尾の姿で登場し、海外のリーク情報によると体の色を6種類、目の色を4種類から選べるとされている。 本物のaiboの現行モデルは国内販売を終了しているが、フォートナイト内では一緒に島を走ることができる。
articles.summary_zh: 索尼的机器人犬“aibo”作为搭档今日登场游戏《堡垒之夜》的道具商城，售价为1500V-BUCKS，销售期限还剩6天。 初代aibo于1999年作为家用娱乐机器人以25万日元的价格发售，并于2006年结束生产，随后于2018年以现行型号ERS-1000复活。 在游戏中，它以白身、棕耳和棕尾的标志性外观出现，据海外爆料信息显示，购买后可在6种身体颜色和4种眼睛颜色中进行选择。 虽然实体aibo现行型号已在日本国内结束销售，但在游戏中玩家可以与其一同在岛上奔跑。

articles.headline: ベトナムと日本は、ロボット工学と半導体チップの分野における科学者ネットワークを構築する必要がある。
articles.summary: 11月9日午後、ト・ラム書記長兼国家主席は高市早苗首相と会談し、ベトナムと日本は包括的戦略パートナーシップを新たなレベルに引き上げることで一致した。 両首脳は、経済安全保障や技術移転、質の高い人材育成での連携強化を確認し、AI、半導体、エネルギー、デジタル、グリーン変革などの分野で協力する方針で合意した。 さらに、2030年までに貿易額800億米ドルを達成することを目指し、ロボット工学や半導体チップなど6分野における科学者ネットワークの構築や、ベトナムでのAI分野の博士号取得者100人育成支援が提案された。 会談後、両首脳は主要分野における9つの協力文書の署名に立ち会い、ベトナム・日本共同ビジョン声明を採択した。 また、ト・ラム書記長兼国家主席は、日本の森英介衆議院議長および関口正和参議院議長とも会談を行い、両国国会間の協力強化を確認した。
articles.summary_zh: 11月9日下午，越共中央总书记兼国家主席苏林同日本首相高市早苗举行会谈，双方一致同意将越日全面战略伙伴关系推向新高度。 两国领导人确认加强经济安全保障、技术转移及高质量人才培训等领域的合作，并在人工智能、半导体、能源、数字化转型和绿色转型等领域推进合作。 双方达成共识，力争到2030年实现800亿美元的双边贸易额，并提出了在机器人、半导体芯片等6个领域建立科学家网络，以及日本支持越南培养100名人工智能领域博士的计划。 会谈后，两国领导人见证了多个领域9份合作文件的签署，并通过了越日共同愿景声明。 此外，苏林还同日本众议院议长森英介及参议院议长关口昌一举行会谈，确认加强两国国会间的合作。

articles.headline: トヨタ、Google系ウェイモとロボットタクシー実証 EVを自動運転化
articles.source: 環境ビジネスオンライン
articles.summary: トヨタ自動車は2026年10月30日、アメリカのGoogle傘下であるウェイモが開発する自動運転システムをトヨタの電気自動車「bZ4X」に搭載し、日本国内で2027年から試験と検証を含む初期運行を始めると発表した。 ウェイモはアメリカ国内各地でロボットタクシーをすでに社会実装しており、近年は日本人がアメリカ現地で試乗する様子が紹介される機会も増えている。
articles.summary_zh: 丰田汽车于2026年10月30日宣布，将采用美国谷歌旗下公司Waymo开发的自动驾驶系统，搭载于丰田的纯电动汽车“bZ4X”上，并计划于2027年起在日本国内开始包含测试与验证在内的初期运行。 Waymo已在美国各地实现了机器人出租车的社会应用，近年来日本人在美国当地试乘Waymo机器人出租车的机会也在不断增加。

articles.headline: 川崎重工、産業用ロボット向け「Fシリーズコントローラ S-type」を発売 サイバーセキュリティ対策機能を強化
articles.summary: 川崎重工業は2026年11月5日、サイバー攻撃などへの対策機能を強化した産業用ロボット向けコントローラ「Fシリーズコントローラ S-type」の発売を開始すると発表した。 製造現場でのIoT化に伴うサイバーセキュリティ対策の重要性の高まりや、欧州連合のEUサイバーレジリエンス法などの動向を背景に開発された。 同製品は、ユーザー認証、アクセス権限管理、通信保護などのセキュリティ機能を強化し、不正アクセスやシステム改ざんのリスク低減を図るほか、国際規格「IEC 62443-4-1」に基づいた開発プロセスが適用されている。
articles.summary_zh: 川崎重工业株式会社于2026年11月5日宣布推出工业机器人控制器“F系列控制器 S-type”，该产品强化了针对网络攻击等的防护功能。 在制造现场物联网化背景下网络安全重要性日益提高，加之欧盟《网络韧性法案》等动向的影响，该产品强化了用户认证、访问权限管理、通信保护等安全功能，以降低未授权访问和系统篡改的风险，并在开发过程中适用了国际标准“IEC 62443-4-1”。

articles.headline: Apple's HALO Lifts Humanoid Robot Stocks; Cold-Snap Energy Chain Draws Funds as China Stocks Churn on Thin Volume
articles.summary: Chinese stocks closed mixed with shrinking trading volume yesterday, while market attention shifted to news-driven themes like humanoid robots, the cold-snap energy chain, and the ice-and-snow economy. Apple unveiled HALO, an autonomous control system for humanoid robots, lifting related stocks such as Swancor Advanced Materials and Xiangming Zhihui to limit-up, though profit-taking pressure remained evident. Meanwhile, coal and natural gas names rose due to domestic production rectifications in Inner Mongolia and Shaanxi and Indonesian export quota controls. The ice-and-snow economy also saw gains from falling temperatures and ski resorts opening, though it remains a seasonal and small-scale niche. Analysts note that without expanding trading volume, index rotation will likely accelerate.
articles.summary_zh: 中国股市昨日在成交量萎缩的情况下收盘分化，市场资金转向人形机器人、寒潮能源链及冰雪经济等新闻驱动的主题。 苹果公司发布了人形机器人自主控制系统HALO，带动上纬新材、湘明智汇等机器人概念股集体涨停，但短线获利回吐压力显现。 同时，受内蒙古、陕西等地部分大煤矿停产整顿及印尼出口配额管控影响，煤炭与天然气板块联袂上涨。 冰雪经济板块也因气温下降和滑雪场开业而走强，但其规模较小且属于季节性分支。 分析人士指出，在成交量明显放大之前，指数底部区间料将维持，板块轮动或将加快。

articles.headline: Video: Boston Dynamics put wheels on Atlas, and now it’s pulling off 360-degree jumps
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics modified its Atlas humanoid robot by replacing its feet with standard electric scooter wheels connected via a custom adapter to the ankle actuators. The experimental platform was developed to test how simulation-trained controllers handle sustained high-speed movement, heavy loads, and actuators pushed near their physical limits, rather than as a planned commercial product. Engineers refined simulated motor models and adjusted reinforcement-learning frameworks to achieve smooth rolling behaviors. The wheeled configuration enabled new maneuvers, including sideways dashes inspired by human foot-sliding motions and a 360-degree jump executed using a trajectory-tracking controller based on human movement data.
articles.summary_zh: 波士顿动力公司对其Atlas人形机器人进行了改装，用通过定制适配器连接到脚踝执行器的标准电动滑轮取代了双脚。 该实验平台旨在测试模拟训练的控制器如何应对持续的高速运动、重负载以及接近物理极限的执行器，而非计划中的商业产品。 工程师们通过优化模拟电机模型并调整强化学习框架，实现了平稳的滚动行为。 轮式配置赋予了机器人新的动作能力，包括受人类滑足动作启发的侧向冲刺，以及利用基于人类运动数据的轨迹跟踪控制器完成的360度跳跃。

articles.headline: UBTECH Partners with Tianyi to Scale Humanoid Robot Adoption
articles.summary: UBTECH and Tianyi Telecom Terminal signed a comprehensive strategic cooperation agreement on November 9, 2026, targeting household-companion and humanoid robot industry scales over the next three years. The partnership combines China Telecom's channel network and customer base with UBTECH's humanoid robot technology. Planned commercial initiatives include coordinated procurement, rental services, bundled AI service packages, and store trials. The companies also established the Tianyi Telecom Terminal–UBTECH Robotics Joint Innovation Laboratory to focus on scenario discovery, product customization, application validation, and standards development, while integrating telecom cloud-network infrastructure and AI capabilities into robot bodies.
articles.summary_zh: 优必选与天翼电信终端于2026年11月9日签署全面战略合作协议，旨在未来三年内推动家庭陪伴及人形机器人行业规模实现增长。 此次合作将中国电信的渠道网络与客户资源同优必选的人形机器人技术相结合。 计划中的商业举措包括协同采购、租赁服务、捆绑AI服务套餐以及门店体验试用。 双方还成立了天翼电信终端-优必选机器人联合创新实验室，专注于场景发掘、产品定制、应用验证和标准制定，同时将电信云网基础设施与AI能力融入机器人机身。

articles.headline: UBTech Teams Up with Tianyi Telecom Terminal in Push for 100,000 Humanoid Robot Sales
articles.summary: UBTech Robotics and Tianyi Telecom Terminal signed a comprehensive strategic cooperation agreement on November 9 to promote large-scale sales of humanoid robots. The partnership targets the home companion robot terminal industry to exceed 1 million units over three years, with combined sales of bionic and wheeled humanoid robots striving to top 100,000 units. The cooperation covers joint promotion, channel sharing, scenario development, and the creation of the Tianyi Terminal-UBTech Robot Joint Innovation Laboratory. Industry observers note that the collaboration addresses the channel gap in robot commercialization by utilizing telecom sales channels and customer contact points to help humanoid robots move from technical validation to large-scale shipments.
articles.summary_zh: 优必选科技与天翼电信终端于11月9日签署全面战略合作协议，以推动人形机器人的大规模销售。 该合作设定了未来三年内家庭陪伴机器人终端行业突破100万台、仿生及轮式人形机器人累计销量力争超过10万台的目标。 合作范围涵盖联合推广、渠道共享、场景开发以及建立天翼终端-优必选机器人联合创新实验室。 行业观察人士指出，此次合作利用电信销售渠道和客户接触点，填补了机器人商业化过程中的渠道短板，有助于推动人形机器人从技术验证向大规模出货迈进。

articles.headline: Boston Dynamics’ Atlas is even more nimble balancing on wheels.
articles.summary: Nearly a decade after introducing the two-wheeled Handle robot, Boston Dynamics released a video showing the Atlas humanoid robot rolling through a simulated warehouse with its feet replaced by tires. The demonstration highlights the robot's adaptability and introduces a quick side dash maneuver to its skillset.
articles.summary_zh: 在推出双轮Handle机器人近十年后，波士顿动力公司发布了一段视频，展示了Atlas人形机器人在将其双脚替换为轮胎后在模拟仓库中滚动的画面。 该演示突显了该机器人的适应性，为其技能组合引入了一项快速侧向冲刺动作。
